import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

rho = [0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.6]
delta = [+0.046, +0.002, -0.020, -0.032]
sd = [None, 0.0025, 0.007, None]
n_seeds = [1, 3, 3, 3]

yerr = [s if s is not None else 0 for s in sd]
has_err = [s is not None for s in sd]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

ax.axhline(y=0, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)

ax.axvspan(0.3, 0.4, alpha=0.15, color='grey', zorder=0)
ax.text(0.35, 0.038, 'transition\nzone', ha='center', va='top',
        fontsize=8, color='grey', fontstyle='italic')

color = '#0072B2'
ax.plot(rho, delta, marker='o', color=color, markersize=7, zorder=3,
        markerfacecolor=color, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.8)

for i in range(len(rho)):
    if has_err[i]:
        ax.errorbar(rho[i], delta[i], yerr=yerr[i], fmt='none',
                    ecolor=color, capsize=4, capthick=1.2, elinewidth=1.2, zorder=4)

ax.annotate('harmful', xy=(0.2, delta[0]), xytext=(0.2 + 0.03, delta[0] + 0.005),
            fontsize=8.5, color='#D62728', va='bottom')

ax.annotate('effective', xy=(0.4, delta[2]), xytext=(0.4 + 0.03, delta[2] - 0.006),
            fontsize=8.5, color='#2CA02C', va='top')
ax.annotate('effective', xy=(0.6, delta[3]), xytext=(0.6 - 0.03, delta[3] - 0.006),
            fontsize=8.5, color='#2CA02C', va='top', ha='right')

ax.set_xlabel(r'$\rho$ (Contamination Ratio)')
ax.set_ylabel(r'$\Delta$ Holdout PPL (Adaptive $-$ Uniform)')
ax.set_xticks(rho)
ax.set_xlim(0.12, 0.68)

ax.grid(False)

fig.savefig('/root/provenance_weight_training/figures/delta_vs_rho.pdf')
fig.savefig('/root/provenance_weight_training/figures/delta_vs_rho.png')
plt.close(fig)
print('Done.')
